text:
alisha: FYI customer (SaaS analytics) asked for private deployment. They want platform fee waiver for a 2–3 week POC and a 20% early-commit discount if they convert to a 12mo reserved commit. Also pushing for Platinum support included. Need guidance on what we can approve.

mike: quick Q for @jamie_dealdesk — can we do a platform fee credit vs full waiver? customer procurement prefers zero platform fee line on PO.

jamie_dealdesk: We can approve marketing credit up to $25k without exec signoff. Anything >$25k requires CRO OK. Need explicit SKU and quote line to code it as MKT-POC-CREDIT.

alisha: POC footprint estimate from them: 2x A100-equivalent nodes, ~60k tokens/day, 2–3 weeks. Proposed temporary SKU: `private-poc-2xA100` with platform fee $5k for POC and `private-support-gold`. They want that platform fee removed entirely.

ellie: From finance: credits vs waivers differ for rev recognition. If you issue a credit, it can be tracked and applied on invoice. If you waive (remove line), legal/finance may flag deferred revenue impacts. Recommend credit line on invoice as marketing credit so accounting is clean.

sanjay: Also technical asks from our side: can we integrate our HSM for key wrapping? need SOC2 + encryption details and confirmation about escalation windows for on-prem.

mike: Yes — customer-managed KMS/HSM supported (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, and on-prem HSM via PKCS#11). I'll drop SOC2 and KMS integration notes. Gold SLA = 99.5% (8x5), Platinum = 99.9% + 24x7 oncall.

jamie_dealdesk: For the 12mo 20% discount: discount applies to platform fee + usage (hosted/dedicated) but not to premium support add-on by default. If they want discount on support, that requires explicit approval and is exceptional. Also need to confirm ARR to ensure they hit the commit tier.

alisha: They project ~$180k ARR if they convert after POC. That should pass the commit threshold (I think threshold is $150k).

jamie_dealdesk: Correct — $180k qualifies for standard commit discount tier. We'll still require a signed order that lists the credit as a separate line if applied for the POC.

ellie: Note: if we give a POC credit conditional on signing the 12mo, finance prefers the credit be contingent (i.e., reversal if they don't sign). Otherwise treat as marketing expense.

mike: Ops note — our on-prem support SKUs (draft pricing) below:
```
private-support-gold: $12,000/yr (8x5, 4h response)
private-support-platinum: $48,000/yr (24x7, 1h response + named oncall + quarterly review)
platform-fee-poc-credit: up to $25,000 (SKU: MKT-POC-CREDIT)
12mo-commit-discount: 20% off platform fee + usage (applies after signed order)
```

jamie_dealdesk: Confirming: we can commit to `platform-fee-poc-credit` up to $25k. Must be coded MKT-POC-CREDIT in the quote. If they want the credit >$25k or a full waiver, escalate to CRO. Any discount on support needs deck approval.

alisha: Customer also asks if quarterly on-site review and runbook handover are included in Platinum — are those standard? also will travel be covered?

mike: Platinum includes a quarterly review (remote by default) and 8 hours/year of runbook/runbook writing assistance. On-site is possible but travel is billable unless negotiated into the support SOW.

jamie_dealdesk: Action items: 1) @alisha update quote with explicit SKUs, credit line (MKT-POC-CREDIT) and 12mo commit terms; 2) @ellie confirm language for invoice credit vs waiver and conditional reversal clause; 3) legal to draft limited IP addendum for early-access code; 4) @mike upload SOC2 + KMS/HSM implementation notes to the quote thread. I'll queue for CRO approval if the requested credit exceeds $25k. :thumbsup: 

sanjay: procurement timeline: need final, signed quote by EOW otherwise review cycles push to next month.

alisha: I can deliver updated quote by Thu COB. tagging @jamie_dealdesk @ellie @mike. :pray:

alisha: thanks everyone — will post the updated quote here when ready.
